purpose: Per CEO R304 P1: 'Create a SIMULATOR_REGISTRY. For each candidate determine: primary_simulator, independent_simulator, reference_dataset, verification_cases, validation_evidence, license, version, reproduction_command, known_limitations. Use external mature tools as the computational substrate.'
constitutional_basis: Article XXXIV (stop coding when reality is the next bottleneck — don't reinvent mature simulators). Article XXVI (no self-certification — use independent external tools).

registry.reference_dataset: Published shunt flow/pressure data (PubMed 15567889: in-vivo shunt dynamics)
registry.verification_cases: Analytical Poiseuille flow, mass conservation, steady-state ICP
registry.validation_evidence: Computational: 225-run ablation, 180-run comparison. Physical: PENDING (bench protocol ready).
registry.license: Open source (our code: MIT). SimVascular: open source (MIT-like).
registry.known_limitations: Lumped-parameter model (not 3D CFD). No pulsatile waveform (constant production). No patient-specific anatomy. Multi_failure peak is model artifact (all paths closed → infinite ICP placeholder).
registry.simulator_strategy: KEEP bespoke for now (validated via ablation). Add SimVascular 0D cross-check as independent verification in future round.

registry.reference_dataset: Published programmable valve pressure-flow curves (Codman Certas, Sophysa Polaris specs)
registry.simulator_strategy: Build bespoke adaptive profiling model. Cross-check with SimVascular 0D valve module.

registry.independent_simulator: Extract as standalone module from P-01

registry.primary_simulator: BESPOQUE (to be built: Architecture E hybrid power budget)
registry.independent_simulator: COMSOL Piezoelectric Device or FEBio (if biomechanics coupling needed)
registry.reference_dataset: Published cardiac harvesting data (PubMed 30784259: 15 μA in vivo, PubMed 40161363: 100μF to 4V in 13min)
registry.simulator_strategy: Build Architecture E power budget model. Cross-check with published in-vivo data.

registry.independent_simulator: MCX (GPU Monte Carlo eXtreme) or MCML (multilayer reference)
registry.reference_dataset: Published transcranial transmission measurements (ScienceDirect 2025: 750/940nm through cadaver heads)
registry.verification_cases: MCML analytical multilayer validation, published tissue optical properties (Jacques 2013)
registry.validation_evidence: NONE YET — R301 code/artifact discrepancy caught in R302. Model requires validation.
registry.license: PyTissueOptics: MIT. MCX: GPL. MCML: public domain.
registry.reproduction_command: TBD — install PyTissueOptics, build multilayer model, run
registry.known_limitations: R301 ballistic model gives ZERO (model error). Diffuse calculation was inline-only (not committed). Code-artifact discrepancy (R302 audit). Thermal model missing. No Monte Carlo cross-check. No experimental validation.
registry.simulator_strategy: Install PyTissueOptics. Build multilayer scalp/skull/CSF/brain model. Run Monte Carlo. Compare with MCML analytical. Validate against published cadaver data. Add thermal model. ONLY THEN update P-16 state.

principle: Our AI orchestrates established scientific engines. It does not pretend to replace them. This is a much stronger technology-transfer architecture than bespoke simulators.
